question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Connote
solution:
The correct answer is "Convey."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• The word "Connote" means (of a word) imply or suggest (an idea or feeling) in addition to the literal or primary meaning. ((किसी शब्द का) शाब्दिक या प्राथमिक अर्थ के अतिरिक्त (एक विचार या भावना) संकेत या सुझाव देना)

 
 
• Example:* To me, chocolate **connotes**__ pleasure and indulgence.*
 
 
 
• The synonym of "Connote" is "Convey."
 
• The word "Convey" means to make ideas, thoughts, feelings, etc. known to somebody. (विचारों, भावनाओं आदि को किसी अन्‍य तक पहुँचाना)
 __
 
• Example: *The film **conveys**__ a lot of information but in an entertaining way.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ 

 
• Comment: **to say what you think or feel about something. (किसी विषय पर अपनी राय देना; टिप्‍पणी करना, सम्‍मति देना)
 
• **Criticize: **to say what is bad or wrong with somebody/something. (किसी की निंदा या आलोचना करना)
 
• **Care: **to be worried about or interested in somebody/something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु की चिंता करना या उसमें रुचि रखना)
